summary: Exa's Free tier gives a user's first team $10 in monthly credits, available in full immediately in the signup month. The monthly grant resets to $10 on the first day of each calendar month; unused monthly credits do not roll over or accumulate. The user's first team also earns a one-time $10 bonus only after the user completes dashboard onboarding; that bonus does not expire. No payment method is required to start. The Free tier excludes Exa Snapshot despite pricing-page wording about access to all endpoints. Published limits include 10 Search QPS and 50 concurrent Agent runs; requests return 402 Payment Required when credits are exhausted.
claim_steps: Create an Exa account and use your first team to receive the full $10 monthly grant immediately, regardless of the signup date. No payment method is required to start.
Complete onboarding in the dashboard to unlock your first team's one-time $10 bonus. The bonus does not expire; it is not an unconditional $20 signup award.

Use monthly credits before they reset to $10 on the first of each calendar month; unused monthly credits do not roll over. Exa Snapshot is excluded. Add paid credits separately if your balance is exhausted.
